اغتنمنا (form VIII)
# اِغْتَنَمْنَا (iḡtanamnā) /iɣ.ta.nam.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# اُغْتُنِمْنَا (uḡtunimnā) /uɣ.tu.nim.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
